title: Custom scheduler, extenders and extension APIs

videos.script: The scheduler is a program like any other. It watches for pods with no node, picks one, and writes the answer back. {{watch}} Nothing stops a second program from doing the same job. A pod says which scheduler it wants, and only that one will place it. {{name}} You will run a second scheduler beside the cluster's own, configured to pack pods onto as few nodes as it can, and watch the two make different choices for the same pods. Then you will look at the other doors the API server leaves open: admission webhooks and whole APIs served by somebody else. {{plan}}
